name: strongman car flip
description: A strongman event where you lift one side of a heavy vehicle and flip it over. It takes full body strength and leg drive.
instructions: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.
